name: Vampires
overview: Scripture clearly prohibits the consumption of blood, emphasizing that the blood represents life and must not be eaten (Leviticus 17:10; Deuteronomy 12:23). This command is reinforced by instructions to abstain from blood and related practices associated with idolatry and pagan rituals (Leviticus 19:26; Acts 15:20; Deuteronomy 32:17). The biblical warnings against these actions highlight the holiness of life as ordained by God and the danger of engaging in practices linked to spiritual rebellion and impurity.
